source_title: SCDOT Guidelines for Movement Over South Carolina Highways of OSOW Vehicles and Loads (Rev 8/2021) + SC Code Title 56 Ch. 5

superload_thresholds.note: SC defines superload by weight: any non-divisible load exceeding 130,000 lbs and/or any single axle exceeding 20,000 lbs triggers additional routing analysis (3-5 business days). Over 180,000 lbs requires a Certificate of Insurance; over 300,000 lbs requires manufacturer weight/dimension docs and may require independent licensed-engineer structural analysis; over 500,000 lbs adds a mega-load impact fee. Route-specific multi-trip permits cap at 130,000 lbs / 15' height. No fixed dimensional superload class (width/height/length null); overwidth is handled by the escort matrix.

width.note: 1 front escort over 12' up to 14' wide on two-lane only; rear escort at Dept discretion (SCDOT OSOW Guidelines Rev 8/2021 Sec. J)
1 front + 1 rear escort over 14' up to 16' wide, all roadways; use 4-lane where possible
over 16' wide: 1 front + 1 rear civilian escort AND 1 front + 1 rear police escort, all roadways (waivable by Permit Director)

height.note: height 16' or greater: 1 front escort with height-measuring pole the entire move + Dept-approved route survey required before issuance

length.note: 1 rear civilian escort overall length 125'-150', all roadways
1 front + 1 rear civilian escort over 150' overall length; rear overhang over 15' also requires a rear escort + 18" red flag

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip permit $30 flat (valid 7 days, one trip). Excess-width surcharge: over 16' +$35, over 18' +$40, over 20' +$45, over 22' +$50. Superload adds a $100 non-refundable application fee + engineering analysis ($100 over 130k / $200 over 200k / $350 over 300k lbs) + $3.00 per 1,000 lbs over 130,000 lbs; over 500,000 lbs adds $0.05 per 1,000 lbs per mile mega-load fee.
single_trip.note: Fee schedule last revised July 1, 2012 (per SCDOT permits page). Max permittable axle groups: single 20,000 / tandem 40,000 / tridem-or-quad 60,000 lbs; any single axle over 20,000 lbs routes to superload.

annual.note: Multiple-trip / annual permit $100 (valid 1 year). House-moving license $100/yr; annual permit transfer $10. Commodity permits: sheet tobacco $15, cotton modular $50, culvert pipe $15.

movement_restrictions: Loads 12' wide or under: sunrise-sunset, Mon-Sun. Over 12' to 15' wide: sunrise-sunset Mon-Sun except near large urban areas (no travel 7-9 a.m. daily, 3-6 p.m. school days, 4:30-6 p.m. non-school days).
Over 15' wide (and mobile homes over 14' box to 16'): only 9 a.m.-3 p.m. school days, 9 a.m.-4 p.m. other days; frame buildings only 9 a.m.-3 p.m. Mon-Fri.
Holiday no-travel: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Fourth of July, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas (Director may extend noon-before to noon-after).
Summer coastal ban: no Sat/Sun travel east of I-95 from Memorial Day to Labor Day (Myrtle Beach corridor routes).
No movement when visibility under 500 ft, high winds, or ice/snow/sleet. Continuous travel available on request for loads 130,000 lbs or under at otherwise-legal dimensions.
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 13'6" (14' only for auto/saddle-mount transporters with routing permit), gross 80,000 lbs interstate (statutory 5-axle base 73,280 lbs non-interstate; SC applies a 10% enforcement tolerance, SC Code §56-5-4160). Semitrailer 53' (kingpin-to-rear-axle 41'), no overall combination length limit.

SC OS/OW permits issued by SCDOT; enforcement by SC DPS State Transport Police. All values sourced from official SCDOT movement guidelines (Rev 8/2021) + SC Code Title 56 Ch. 5 fetched 2026-07-16. A separate SCDOT 'Size and Weight Guidelines (updated 3.2026)' companion doc was referenced but not retrievable; movement guidelines Rev 8/2021 remain authoritative for escort/fee/superload. State-level rules only.
